The television nominations were announced on December 5, 2024.{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2024/12/critics-choice-awards-2024-tv-nominations-shogun-1236195173/ |title='Shōgun' Leads with Six Critics Choice Awards TV Nominations – Full List |last=Pedersen |first=Erik |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=December 5, 2024 |access-date=December 6, 2024}} The film nominations were announced on December 12, 2024.{{cite web |url=https://deadline.com/2024/12/critics-choice-awards-2024-film-nominations-1236201448/ |title='Conclave' and 'Wicked' Lead Critics Choice Awards Film Nominations – Full List |last=Evans |first=Greg |work=[[Deadline Hollywood]] |date=December 12, 2024 |access-date=December 12, 2024}} ''[[Conclave (film)|Conclave]]'' and ''[[Wicked (2024 film)|Wicked]]'' led the film nominations with eleven each, followed by ''[[Dune: Part Two]]'' and ''[[Emilia Pérez]]'' with ten apiece. ''[[Shōgun (2024 TV series)|Shōgun]]'' led the television nominations with six, followed by ''[[Abbott Elementary]]'', ''[[The Diplomat (American TV series)|The Diplomat]]'', ''[[Disclaimer (TV series)|Disclaimer]]'', ''[[Hacks]]'', ''[[The Penguin (TV series)|The Penguin]]'' and ''[[What We Do in the Shadows (TV series)|What We Do in the Shadows]]'' with four each.
